_comment: First-party Farmer's Delight WILD-RICE compat on the LUSH family (FARMERSDELIGHTPLAN #16). Lush islands always carry the base water pond, so this is the RELIABLE rice bootstrap: wild_rice is added to the pond's plant list. wild_rice is a two-tall waterlogged plant — PondCarver.plantInPond has a dedicated 'wild_rice' case that stands it at the water surface (panicles above the waterline). NOTE: 'pond' is a scalar-REPLACE (no list-merge), so this pond is a verbatim copy of lush.json's base pond (water r4 d3 + axolotls) with wild_rice appended — re-sync if the base pond changes. Inert without FD: placePondPlants gates on Lookup.hasBlock, so an unknown wild_rice id is skipped → byte-identical generation. IDS VERIFIED vs FarmersDelight-1.21.1-1.3.2.jar (2026-07-03).
